content.text: Five Card Draw with one Joker as Bug: counts as Ace or completes straight or flush only.

Five Card Draw is one of the oldest forms of poker and was the best known internationally until Texas Hold'em's rise at the end of the 20th century. The Bug variant adds one joker to make 53 cards; the joker is a limited wild that can represent an ace or complete a straight or flush, used to increase the proportion of good hands in home and club play.
Two to six players; six makes the best game. With seven or eight the deck may run out during the draw, so six is normally the maximum.
Standard 52-card pack plus one joker (53 cards total). The joker is used as the Bug, a limited wild that may represent an ace or complete a straight or flush only.
After shuffle and cut, the dealer deals five cards face down to each player, one at a time clockwise.
